name: Lažany (Czechia)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly by a white band into a blue lower hoist part bearing a white Maltese cross and a red upper fly part bearing a white crown-like charge.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 17 February 2006 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
